title: The Mute Immortals Speak: Pre-Islamic Poetry and the Poetics of Ritual

publication.publisher_or_container: Cornell University Press (Myth and Poetics series)

verification.verification_notes: Author, title, publisher, year, ISBN, and the thesis that qasidah poetry is ritualized in form and function verified via Cornell University Press, library catalogs, and a Cambridge review. The ritha' material and the descent of elegiac repetition/address from wailing-women's nawh verified via the Cambridge review and a peer-reviewed article on the Arabic elegy that cites Stetkevych and Goldziher.

copyright.notes: Scholarly monograph containing the author's own translations; analytical paraphrase only, no reproduced translations.
